title: Poultry low-temperature safety note
description: Flag possible low-temperature poultry cooking for editorial review. Explicit 140°F hot holding of cooked food is distinguished from cooking when a 165°F / 74°C endpoint is also present; an explicitly sliced-pork 145°F endpoint with a three-minute wait is also distinguished. This heuristic does not certify safety.
suggestionTemplate: Review the low-temperature poultry reference in context. A valid process depends on both time and temperature and the food being cooked; do not infer pasteurization from a temperature alone. Distinguish raw cooking from reheating and hot holding.
